method: A door use has no native player animation: an ordinary tap runs Interact75 for about a frame beside Running0 (and Undraw81 around a second tap), with no first-person reach scene (chapter 47, 638-642). The source reads the native use event and the partner plays the authored reach as use variant 1 (generic) on the use clock (protocol 74); the door leaf itself is native and its state is shared by the door desired-state adapter (chapters 56-57). The locked office door (ld_door_350cm_int_rich_wood_01) answers a tap with the native 'Royal Quarters Key needed' message: the use registers and the partner reaches for the handle, the leaf stays shut. The adjacent unlocked door (ld_door_350cm_int_rich_wood_01_3) opens on the first tap and closes on the second (Test-UseVariants-v1228r -SecondUse). For the locked door the observer's free camera stands over the partner's right shoulder (back 0.9 m, side -0.6 m, eye 2.1 m, pitch 28); for the unlocked door that spot is inside the wall (1228zh/zi), so the camera holds at the chapter 47 spot inside the office facing the doorway ([-44,-161,68.1], yaw 220; Test-UseVariants-v1228s -CamAt). A case passes when the native use registers and the observer presents the reach at full weight.

items.scope: Opening and closing an unlocked door and trying a locked one, in both roles: the partner reaches for the handle on the native use clock and settles back; the door leaf and its state are native and shared.

visual.verdict: Locked door: Corvo reaches his right hand forward to the handle of the office door, which stays shut, and lowers it again.
Locked door: Emily steps to the office door, reaches her right hand to the handle and returns to stand when it does not open.
Unlocked door: the leaf swings open toward the camera and Corvo stands in the doorway, his right hand out at the door edge; he lowers it, and the leaf closes on the second tap.
Unlocked door: the leaf swings open and Emily stands in the doorway with her right hand out at the door edge, lowers it and stands while the leaf closes on the second tap.
